description: This file defines the LayoutWorker class, which provides utility methods for handling image uploads via HTTP requests in a web application framework. It processes multipart form data, extracts uploaded files, and prepares image data for further use.

classes.name: LayoutWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for processing image uploads in a web application, handling multipart form data, extracting file bytes, and preparing image data for storage or further processing.

methods.name: uploadImageAndParameters
methods.description: Handles an HttpServletRequest to parse uploaded files, extract image data associated with a specified form field, and return metadata and data buffers for the uploaded image.

methods.name: returnByteBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the ByteBuffer associated with image data from the provided map.
